annotations.title: Dutch house prices for a postcode (paid)

description: Use when the user asks what homes cost in a Dutch area: average home value (WOZ) in the neighbourhood with its trend, plus actual average sale prices per year in the municipality vs the national average. Context for an asking price, not a valuation of one home. Input: postcode or CBS buurt code. Source: CBS, Kadaster. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

code.description: Alternative: CBS neighbourhood code, e.g. BU05182245

postcode.description: Any Dutch postcode in the neighbourhood, e.g. 2517AS
